about: The characters and what each one wears (Christian, Oct 13, 2026): read by the Studio's Characters tab, which shows a matrix of who has which piece, and what a category or a Note gives each of them, with the prompt for any gap. A new character is an entry here (its pieces, its template, its prompts) plus its player and kit. Pieces: look (a look in looks.json: GlazyArray's has a file; Starlee's are the looks marked "marley": true, her hat and charm cut by Claude, js/marley.js HOL), backdrop (the scene behind the Listen bar, assets/narrator/backdrops, shared), tank (A.L.T.A.'s own scenes, assets/alta/backdrops; without one she stays in her hall). In the prompts, {look}, {a}, {b}, {hat}, {charm}, {hatShort}, {charmShort} and {place} are filled in by the Studio.

look.how: Run Prompt 1 on her template, then Prompt 2 on the image it made, and bring that back to Add a look in the Categories tab (the Studio keys it and puts her face back).
look.prompt:
Prompt 1:

Same image, same camera, same face, same eyes, same jaw, same neck and the same flat chroma green background (#00B140). Change only the hair and accessories: {look}. Render {a} in a bright saturated magenta (#FF00FF) with natural shading and gloss, and {b} in plain pearl white with natural shading and gloss. Everything else in her style: polished brass and rose-gold, chunky sculpted shapes, nothing crossing her face below the brows. No text, letters or logos.

Prompt 2 (on the image Prompt 1 made):

Same image, exactly as it is. Change only {b} from pearl white to a bright saturated cyan (#00FFFF), keeping the shading, gloss and folds. Change nothing else: the magenta stays magenta, and the brass, hair, face and green background stay exactly the same.

look.how: Paste her description from assets/marley/KIT.md first, run Prompt 1 on her flat-green seated template, then Prompt 2 on the image it made, and bring both renders to Bring in a look (this tab): your browser cuts her hat and charm from them and shows her wearing them before you add them.
look.prompt:
Prompt 1 (after her description):

Same image, exactly as it is. Add only {hat} on her head, sitting between her ears, and {charm} about the size of a coin hanging from the ring at the front of her collar, each in its own colours with natural shading and shine. No text, letters or logos. Her pose, her ears, her face and the flat chroma green background (#00B140) stay exactly the same.

Prompt 2 (on the image Prompt 1 made):

Same image, exactly as it is. Paint only the {hatShort} and the {charmShort} a flat, saturated cyan (#00FFFF), keeping their shading and shine. Everything else stays exactly the same.

tahoe-winter: a chunky knit beanie with a pom-pom
valentines: a red velvet bow on a slim headband between her ears
spring: a headband with soft bunny ears
fourth-of-july: a small straw boater hat with a striped band
thanksgiving: a knitted autumn beanie with a maple leaf on it

tank.how: Give your image tool her empty tank template with this prompt (the scene goes on its own line in the middle), and bring the render back to Bring in a scene (this tab): it shows her resting in front of it and the scene as she dives, and turns away a picture with her painted in.
